description: Full change impact report: risk score + mitigations, breaking change detection, enriched dependents (complexity, coverage, exports), module groups, affected tests, co-change hidden couplings. Pass symbol_ids to scope to changed symbols. Use before modifying code. For a quick risk score alone use assess_change_risk; for who-calls-what use get_call_graph. compact pages results; bundle recalls. Read-only. Returns JSON: { risk, dependents, affectedTests, breakingChanges, totalAffected }.

decorator_filter.description: Filter dependents to only those with this decorator/annotation/attribute (e.g. "Route", "Transactional", "csrf_protect")

fqn.description: Fully qualified name to analyze (alternative to symbol_id)

symbol_ids.description: Diff-aware: only analyze impact of these specific symbols (e.g. from get_changed_symbols)

name: get_change_impact
